instruction: Put the blue ball into the small bin, let go and move the hand away.

outcome.real_measurement: In the bin: the generalized winding number of the bin's open inner surface (floor + 4 walls up to the rim) at the ball's support point (lowest point, 2 mm inside the ball) is > 0.5, i.e. more than half of the directions from that point are blocked by the bin. The ball's CENTRE is the wrong query point here: a 4 cm ball resting on the floor of this 1 cm deep bin has its centre 1 cm above the rim (winding number ~0.30). Real world: 6-DoF poses of both objects from a calibrated camera (fiducials or model-based tracking) at the control rate; the same computation on the tracked poses.
Supported by the bin: ball-bin contact impulse > 0 in every judged step.
The ball does not touch the table.

Commanded vs actual opening (v3.2, E24c fix 3): for every arm whose gripper is within 3 cm of a judged object, measured opening minus the free-space opening of its current gripper command <= 5 mm at every judged step (a gripper still closing on, or propped open by, something fails). Real world: gripper encoder vs command.

Consequence test after the judged window (protocol v3.1/v3.2): every arm whose gripper is within 3 cm of the ball retracts its TCP 3 cm along its approach axis in 0.5 s with its last gripper command unchanged, then holds 0.5 s; the ball must move <= 1 cm. Real world: same motion, tracked pose.
Settled: the fastest bounding-box corner of every judged object moves <= 2 cm/s at every judged step, speed from positions (v3.2, E24c fix 1). Real world: frame differencing of the tracked pose.
Stays put: the sphere centre moves <= 2 mm over the judged window. Real world: tracked pose, 1 s.

source.protocol: v3 (veritask, unchanged) + imsim v3.2 signals (imsim/imsim/verify/v32.py): position-based speeds, all-link enclosure, retreat aftermath, commanded vs actual opening, 5 s settle cap
source.released_code_predicate: ball within 5 mm of the bin centre (xy) and at floor height +-5 mm, PhysX velocity < 1 cm/s and 0.5 rad/s, not is_grasping, one step

notes: D2 winding-number variant of imsim_place_sphere_v1: its two distance terms (ball-bin xy <= 1 cm, ball at floor height +-5 mm) are replaced by one winding-number term; every other term, the release block and the settle block are copied unchanged. Adds a lift-and-tilt proof test. Needs the pose signals sphere_* and bin_* (recorder imsim.verify.topo_tasks.place_sphere_wn; for E29b trace files they are added from a reset with the episode's seed, the bin being kinematic and never moved). Ball bounding box = 4 cm cube (rotates with the ball, so rolling counts as motion).
